description:
Readouts, approvals and trial starts across sponsors, soonest first. Called bare, it answers what comes next.

With neither from_date nor to_date, the window starts today, because what comes next is what a bare call is for
and the answer used to be months of events that had already happened. `window` in the response gives the dates
actually used. Add pending_only=true to drop events whose outcome is already recorded, and kind="readout" for
trial results. To look back, give from_date or to_date explicitly; either one on its own turns the default off.

from_date and to_date take YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM, YYYY-Qn or YYYY. An event is dated as precisely as its sponsor
guided it (a day, a month, a quarter or a year), and it is kept when that period overlaps the window, so an event
guided to 2026-Q4 is still listed from 2026-11-10.

area: "obesity" or "diabetes". kind: "readout" (trial results, including cardiovascular outcomes trials),
"regulatory" (submissions, decisions, coverage and launches), "trial_start" or "company" (earnings, conferences,
investor days). pending_only: only events with no outcome recorded yet.
